desc.zh_TW: 劫後餘生的村莊，長老仍守在這裡。
desc.en: The village that survived the disaster; the elder still keeps watch here.
desc.zh_CN: 劫后余生的村庄，长老仍守在这里。
desc.ja: 災厄を生き延びた村。長老が今も見守っている。
desc.ko: 재앙에서 살아남은 마을. 장로가 여전히 이곳을 지키고 있습니다.
desc.es: El pueblo que sobrevivió al desastre; el anciano aún vigila aquí.

desc.zh_TW: 從塔裡救回來的麵包師又生起了爐火。
desc.en: The baker you freed from the tower has lit the oven again.
desc.zh_CN: 从塔里救回来的面包师又生起了炉火。
desc.ja: 塔から救い出したパン屋が、また窯に火を入れた。
desc.ko: 탑에서 구해 낸 제빵사가 다시 화덕에 불을 지폈다.
desc.es: El panadero que rescataste de la torre ha vuelto a encender el horno.

desc.zh_TW: 武師在燒焦的院子裡磨著刀。
desc.en: The weapon master sharpens blades in his scorched yard.

desc.zh_TW: 從塔裡救回來的治療師，在這裡替人療傷。
desc.en: The healer you freed from the tower tends the wounded here.

desc.zh_TW: 小托又躲回他最愛的木桶裡了，不過這次是在玩。
desc.en: Tobi is back in his favourite barrel. This time he's only playing.

desc.zh_TW: 皮普在村口擺了個攤，每樣東西都貴一點點。
desc.en: Pip has set up a stall by the gate. Everything costs a little too much.

desc.zh_TW: 鐵匠的爐火又燒起來了。
desc.en: The blacksmith's forge is burning again.

desc.zh_TW: 攤滿地圖的桌子，上面畫著塔的每一層。
desc.en: A table covered in maps of every floor of the tower.

desc.zh_TW: 旅店的煙囪又冒煙了，整條街都是燉肉的香味。
desc.en: The inn's chimney is smoking again. The whole street smells of stew.

desc.zh_TW: 學者把救回來的書一本本晾乾。
desc.en: The scholar is drying out the books he saved, one by one.
